results.notes: pystac_client.Client.open(http://honua:5000/stac) returned STAC 1.1.0 Catalog id='honua-stac-catalog'; pystac.Catalog.from_dict rehydrated the same document.
docker/client-compat runs an HTTP-only bridge network, so this lane certifies cleartext transport; TLS is exercised in the release tier against the HTTPS candidate.

Anonymous GET /api/v1/admin/services -> 401 with WWW-Authenticate='ApiKey realm="Honua Admin", header="X-API-Key"'; pystac-client's StacApiIO surfaced the same status as APIError. Raw httpx used because the control plane is not a STAC endpoint.

GET /api/v1/admin/services with X-API-Key -> 200. Honua's control plane is API-key authenticated; HTTP Basic is an opt-in compatibility mode that also refuses non-HTTPS transport, and there is no bearer/login flow for this surface.
pystac_client.Client.get_collections() yielded 5 collection(s): 0, 2000, 2001, 2002, 3000.

Item 1 exposed 13 properties covering the seeded schema plus eo:cloud_cover=5; validated against the published STAC JSON Schemas.
All 9 geometry-bearing items reported GeoJSON Point; the one seeded null-geometry row kept an explicit JSON null.
CQL2-JSON status='active' returned 5/10 items.
client.search(bbox=[-122.495, 37.705, -122.455, 37.735]) returned 3 items (1, 2, 3), every one inside the envelope.

alpha returned (-122.49, 37.71) against seeded (-122.49, 37.71); max abs deviation 0.0 <= 1e-06.

extensions.notes: core honored: landing page carries ['child', 'conformance', 'data', 'http://www.opengis.net/def/rel/ogc/1.0/queryables', 'root', 'search', 'self', 'service-desc', 'service-doc'] and /stac/conformance publishes the same 14 classes.
collections honored: all 5 listed collections (0, 2000, 2001, 2002, 3000) round-tripped through get_collection(id).
ogcapi-features honored: /items honored limit and bbox and every returned feature rehydrated under pystac.Item.from_dict.
item-search honored: landing page advertises ['GET', 'POST'] search links and both methods returned 10 items.
item-search#fields honored: include narrowed properties to the requested set and exclude removed only properties.tags.
item-search#sort honored: +properties.name and -properties.name produced exactly reversed orderings over 10 items.
item-search#filter honored: queryables publish 16 properties (dialect https://json-schema.org/draft/2019-09/schema) and a CQL2-JSON comparison on eo:cloud_cover narrowed to 5 items.
oas30 honored: service-desc served OpenAPI 3.0.3 with 9 paths; service-doc link present.
basic-cql2 honored in both dialects: an AND of an equality and a numeric comparison returned the same 3 items via cql2-json and cql2-text.
intersects(Polygon) and the equivalent bbox both returned ['1', '2', '3'].
intersects(Point) at the anchor coordinate matched exactly the anchor item; a degenerate point geometry is the classic spatial-predicate edge case.
datetime=2024-01-03T12:00:00Z matched exactly the one seeded item at that instant.
A closed RFC 3339 interval selected the three items inside it, with both endpoints treated inclusively.
Open-start ../T returned ['1', '2', '3'] and open-end T/.. returned ['10', '8', '9']; the two halves are disjoint.
ids=['2', '4'] returned exactly those items; an unknown id returned an empty FeatureCollection rather than an error or the whole collection.
collections=['0'] returned 10 items all bearing that collection back-reference; the unscoped search spanned ['0', '2000', '2001', '2002', '3000']; an unknown collection matched nothing.
An identical bbox + datetime + sortby search returned the same ordered ids (['1', '2', '3']) over both GET and POST.
limit=3 with max_items=4 crossed a page boundary and yielded four distinct items.
pages() walked to exhaustion in page sizes [3, 3, 3, 1], collecting all 10 seeded items with no duplicates and terminating without a next link.
ItemSearch.matched()=10 agrees with numberMatched=10 and numberReturned=3 equals the actual feature count on the page.
GET next uses a token query parameter; POST next is a body-bearing method=POST merge=true link whose token advanced the cursor to a disjoint page.

limit=1000000 clamped to the server maximum and still answered 200; limit=0 was rejected with status=400 title='Bad Request' detail='limit must be greater than or equal to 1.'. Raw httpx used because pystac-client refuses out-of-range limits client-side.
A token past the end returned an empty FeatureCollection with no next link; a malformed token was rejected with status=400 title='Bad Request' detail='Invalid pagination token.'.
All 1 assets on item 1 (geojson) carried href/type/roles and resolved with a matching content type.
9 items had a bbox containing their geometry; the 1 null-geometry item correctly omitted bbox.
Item 1 carried ['collection', 'parent', 'root', 'self'] links; the self link re-fetched the same item and the collection link resolved to the owning collection.
All 10 items carried an RFC 3339 UTC datetime that pystac parsed into a timezone-aware value with zero offset.
stac_extensions declared: none; eo:cloud_cover present on items: True. The fixture's eo:cloud_cover is projected without the server claiming the EO extension schema, which is legal but worth naming.
Catalog: validated against the published STAC JSON Schemas; Collection: validated against the published STAC JSON Schemas; Item: validated against the published STAC JSON Schemas

Required members present (license='proprietary', stac_version=1.0.0, links ['alternate', 'http://www.opengis.net/def/rel/ogc/1.0/queryables', 'items', 'parent', 'root', 'self']); optional members present: ['title'].
/stac/collections returned 5 entries, each rehydrating under pystac.Collection with a spatial extent.
GET an unknown item -> status=404 title='Not Found' detail="Item '999999' not found in collection '0'."; pystac-client surfaced it as APIError(status_code=404).

3-value bbox -> status=400 title='Bad Request' detail='bbox must contain four or six numeric values.'; inverted bbox -> status=400 title='Bad Request' detail='bbox latitude values are out of range.'; out-of-range bbox -> status=400 title='Bad Request' detail='bbox latitude values are out of range.'.
datetime=not-a-date -> status=400 title='Bad Request' detail='Invalid datetime parameter.'; reversed interval -> status=400 title='Bad Request' detail='Invalid datetime parameter.'.

filter-lang=bogus-lang -> status=400 title='Bad Request' detail="Invalid filter-lang 'bogus-lang'."; filter-lang without filter -> status=400 title='Bad Request' detail='filter-lang and filter-crs require a filter parameter.'.
GET /api/v1/admin/services with an incorrect X-API-Key -> 401. Raw httpx: the control plane is not a STAC endpoint.
An unknown search query parameter -> status=400 title='Bad Request' detail='Unknown query parameter: not-a-real-parameter'.
